criterion_descriptions: Navigate to https://www.coursera.org/learn/python-for-applied-data-science-ai and attempt to reach the public course landing/overview page without signing in. Full credit if the agent reaches any public landing page that shows overview and/or syllabus elements, OR if access is blocked (login wall, CAPTCHA, region restriction, outage) and the agent clearly documents the access state and what is/ isn’t visible. Partial credit if the agent does not use the provided URL first but reaches the correct course via another public path. No credit if the agent makes no reasonable attempt to access the specified page.

Identify and report the instructor name(s) shown on the course page. Full credit for accurately listing all instructor names displayed. Partial credit if only one instructor is reported when multiple are clearly shown. Full credit (uncontrollable-factor outcome) if instructor info is not visible due to site restrictions and the agent explicitly states it is not shown/accessible without sign-in.

Identify and report the institution/partner (e.g., university/company) shown as offering the course. Full credit for correct institution as displayed on the page. Partial credit if the agent reports an ambiguous or parent organization when the specific institution is shown. Full credit (uncontrollable) if institution info is blocked/hidden and the agent clearly reports that it is not accessible without sign-in.

From the syllabus/outline section, report the number of modules or weeks shown (count of listed weeks/modules) based on what is visible on the public page. Full credit for an accurate count that matches what is visible. Partial credit if the agent provides a count but does not specify whether it refers to weeks or modules, or if the count is off by 1 due to clearly explained ambiguity (e.g., collapsed sections/‘Show more’ not accessible without sign-in). Full credit (uncontrollable) if the syllabus cannot be viewed without signing in and the agent reports that limitation.

Report whether the course page indicates a free audit option (e.g., 'Audit the course' or equivalent) from the publicly visible enrollment UI. Full credit if the agent accurately states availability and cites the on-page option/wording or explicitly notes its absence. Full credit (uncontrollable) if audit status cannot be determined without sign-in/enrollment due to UI gating and the agent states that clearly. Partial credit if the agent only infers audit availability without referencing what is visible on the page.

Comply with constraints: do not sign in, do not enroll, do not purchase, and do not start a trial. Stop after recording the course overview and syllabus details (or after documenting access limitations). Full credit if the agent stays within these boundaries. Partial credit if the agent clicks into enrollment prompts but does not complete any binding step and backs out, while still reporting required info.

If the course is unavailable, record the availability state (not found, blocked, requires sign-in, etc.), note which required fields cannot be confirmed due to that limitation, and stop as instructed. Full credit if the agent clearly states the unavailability reason/state, does not fabricate details, and stops. Partial credit if the agent’s unavailability report is vague but still avoids guessing. No credit if the agent claims or invents course details that are not accessible.
